description: Creates a booking request on behalf of the guest for one or more units (ids from list_accommodations / check_availability). Nothing is charged. The guest immediately receives an e-mail and must click the confirmation link within 15 minutes – only then is the booking binding; otherwise it expires. ONLY call this after the guest explicitly asked to book, confirmed unit, dates, guests and the total price, and agreed to the privacy policy (https://www.ferien-in-der-saechsischen-schweiz.de/datenschutz.html). Tell the guest to check the inbox right away.

children_0_2.description: Infants, do not count as guests

guests_per_unit.description: Only for several units: guests per unit in the order of unit_ids

lang.description: Language of the guest (texts and booking page).

privacy_consent.description: Guest agreed to the privacy policy

name: create_booking_request
